title.zh: Tether says it helped freeze $550M in Iran-linked USDT this year
title.en: Tether says it helped freeze $550M in Iran-linked USDT this year

current_state.zh: Tether said it helped freeze nearly $550 million in Iran-linked USDT in 2026, including over $344 million tied to the Central Bank of Iran, as Senate Democratic investigators released a report alleging USDT had become central to Iran's shadow banking network and called for scrutiny of the issuer.
